basic_info.description: Stunning 2-bed, 2-bath condo at VIDA, with 1-car assigned parking. Mesmerizing views of San Francisco's skyline, peek-a-boo glimpses of the Golden Gate Bridge and the Marin Headlands.    Bright and airy open-concept floor plan, featuring sleek, engineered wood floors and large windows that flood the space with natural light. The living area offers an ideal setting to unwind or entertain, all while soaking in the stunning vistas of the city. The spacious kitchen is equipped with top-of-the-line appliances including a Bosch cooktop/oven and dishwasher, creating a perfect space for entertaining over your extra large peninsula outfitted with quartz counters.    The primary suite includes an en-suite bath with walk-in shower and abundant closet space. The living room separates the primary suite from the second multifunctional bedroom for optimum privacy. Bedroom 2 is conveniently located next to the guest bathroom. In-unit laundry, designated parking space, and deeded storage cage. Bonus feature: sellers tell us they have seen, from the unit, the movies projected on the wall at Foreign Cinema!     Building amenities:  lobby attendant, rooftop deck w/ BBQ, fitness center, bike storage and a stylish lobby lounge.    Near vibrant Mission and Valencia corridors. Easy to BART, MUNI, & Fwys
